picks.rationale: Hold Stroud at $5,700. The freshly inspected Giants tracker documents 1,714 season passing yards and Houston's two-game recovery; he remains unpaired with a Texans receiver. This is not a claim that a favorable game script is guaranteed.
Hold the $6,700 allocation and prior observed 28-carry, 120-yard role evidence. This pass did not establish a new Carolina role change; final Week7 availability remains unverified.

Hold Pollard's $5,300 rushing-role allocation provisionally: fresh game log shows 14,17,16,14,19 carries after the opener, but zero catches in each of the last two games. Cleveland's defensive resistance and shared Pollard/Titans script exposure make this the weakest hold.

Hold Puka at $8,400 after official confirmation Adams will miss time. A central receiving role is a more defensible inference than assuming all vacated targets transfer to him; added coverage attention and a weaker supporting offense remain counterarguments.

Hold Nabers at $6,800. Official tracker records 29 catches/398 yards over three games but still contains no starting-QB announcement. Keep the target-role case separate from a claimed McCarthy upgrade.
Hold Godwin at $4,300 on the prior eight-target involvement case. No fresh role-changing report established in this focused pass; QB and target-allocation uncertainty remain.

Hold LaPorta at $4,800 using the prior pre-bye involvement case and avoiding a second Giants receiver. The cheap Ferguson alternative is not usable in Week7: NFL reporting places IR return eligibility at Week8.

Hold Keenan at $4,800. Freshly inspected game log shows 9,9,11 targets in his last three appearances, strengthening the case beyond one game. The last two came in losses; no nine-target floor or full-route guarantee is assumed.

Hold Tennessee DST at $2,600 for salary/opponent context. Cleveland's official recap documents early offensive pressure and three first-half sacks, but later comeback success; pressure opportunities do not guarantee sacks or turnovers.

summary: Hold all nine at$49,400/$600left. Keenan's target case now has three-appearance support; Pollard's low receiving role remains the weakest hold. Reject Ferguson forWeek7, watch Mumpfield without assuming inherited targets. First qualified Week7 SPAGS snapshot:133.1 external projected points; no historical backfill.
strongest_counterargument: The external model favors Braelon17.3 over Pollard12.4 for exactly the unused$600. If Hall remains out, retaining Pollard may discard the better opportunity. Pollard has no catches in two games and Cleveland's defensive resistance adds risk; Pollard plus Titans DST share game-script exposure. Mumpfield could exceed the cautious role view at a much lower price. Puka's opportunity may rise while offensive efficiency falls.

Rams rotation/Atwell reports establish an actual receiving role for Mumpfield; Ferguson remains excluded from thisWeek7 candidate set.
Giants QB/protection news changes Nabers risk without treating desperation volume as normal.
An explicit official slate/pool change is preserved and explained rather than silently changing the target.

expectations.subject: Keenan Allen
expectations.statement: If healthy, Keenan remains a central Colts receiving option rather than being displaced into a marginal target role.
expectations.support: Last three appearances show9,9,11 targets in the inspected data log.
expectations.uncertainty: Passing volume, coverage and health may change. No repeated9-target floor asserted.
expectations.challenge: A reduced role, missed time or other receivers clearly taking priority would challenge the rationale.
expectations.observe: Compare targets and catches with team pass attempts and other receivers. Use route/snap evidence only if actually accessible; otherwise leave it unassessable.

expectations.subject: Tony Pollard
expectations.statement: If available, Pollard retains the lead share of Titans RB carries; the selection does not depend on a newly expanded receiving role.
expectations.support: The game log shows14,17,16,14,19 carries after Week1 and no catches in the last two games.
expectations.uncertainty: Game script and Spears usage may reduce carries. Cleveland defensive resistance remains a risk.
expectations.challenge: Spears or another RB taking the rushing lead, or Pollard losing meaningful participation, would undermine the hold.
expectations.observe: Compare each Titans RB's carries, targets and receiving work; separate opportunity from rushing efficiency/TDs. Examine script only with inspected play evidence.

expectations.subject: Puka Nacua
expectations.statement: With Adams unavailable, Puka remains a central Rams receiving option; vacated production will not be treated as a one-for-one transfer.
expectations.support: Team confirms Adams' extended absence; NFL report identifies Puka's continuing major receiving role.
expectations.uncertainty: Coverage concentration and offensive efficiency can offset additional opportunity.
expectations.challenge: A role reduction or a documented redistribution that removes his central involvement would challenge the allocation.
expectations.observe: Compare target involvement across Rams receivers and tight ends, then efficiency and scoring. Coverage mechanism remains unassessable without eligible charting.

expectations.subject: Malik Nabers
expectations.statement: Nabers retains central receiving involvement despite the unresolved quarterback situation.
expectations.support: Official tracker documents29 catches398yards across the last three games.
expectations.uncertainty: QB decision, protection and game script may alter ordinary passing volume.
expectations.challenge: Availability/role changes or a substantially redistributed passing game would challenge keeping this salary slot.
expectations.observe: Inspect actual starting QB and substitutions, receiver targets and game conditions. Do not retroactively use relief-quarter success to justify the pregame choice.
